reviewType: Independent provisional owner and seven-step content review

checks.sourceAndDetector: The source explicitly says works around the clock and the new pattern matches the expression; the canonical 1343 detector is limited to round-the-clock supervision.
checks.englishAndChinese: Natural and faithful across checked model, options, writing answers and takeaways; completion and one-person-without-rest overclaims are avoided.
checks.reply: All four answers independently address the stated shifts and testing status; only the golden reply contains the target.
checks.writingAndGlossary: Both complete models satisfy the changed community-site situation; five glossary spans are answer-derived and exclude the target.
checks.audio: Four distinct transcript roles are present in the focused build; listening to generated clips remains a separate release gate.

findings.detail: The brief correctly distinguishes adverbial around the clock from attributive round-the-clock supervision, but no assessed task makes the learner choose between those constructions. The scene and contrast test all-hour coverage and an overnight gap, as canonical 1343 already does; the dialogue also rejects a gap, while the reply uses shifts. Semantic and pedagogic overlap remains greater than the owner report suggests.
findings.recommendedRepair: Revise at least one assessed decision to test the adverbial placement against the adjective-plus-noun construction while retaining the source sense; then repeat independent review. Alternatively obtain explicit human owner-scope approval before selecting a separate lesson.

selectionRecommendation: Keep unselected until the owner-scope issue is resolved; this finding does not reject the source expression or assert the two spellings are always interchangeable.
